subject: owl
name: 猫头鹰
label: 圆眼小猫头鹰
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One little owl perched on a short plain branch, rounded head, two large eyes, simple folded wings.
STRICT RENDERING: Only clean pure black contour lines. All body interiors are completely blank white or transparent. Absolutely no shading, no gray tones, no washes, no feather marks or material texture. Put the complete artwork inside the center 65 percent of the canvas so every extremity has a generous blank margin. Simplify the owl to a round body, round head, two plain eyes and one curved folded-wing boundary. Plain short branch, no leaf decoration.
